# SiteSutra acceptance checklist

Adapt to your written scope. Mark only checks actually completed; this is not a certification.

- [ ] Agreed pages/content approved
- [ ] Links and navigation tested
- [ ] Mobile layouts and keyboard focus checked
- [ ] Forms validated, errors tested and real receipt confirmed
- [ ] Booking timezone and calendar receipt confirmed
- [ ] Old URLs and redirect status/destinations tested
- [ ] Titles, headings, canonicals and sitemap checked
- [ ] Public crawl access and private access controls checked
- [ ] Image permissions and text alternatives reviewed
- [ ] Account ownership, source files and editing instructions handed over
- [ ] Support scope and recurring costs recorded
- [ ] Previous version/rollback recorded
- [ ] Named approver authorises launch
